svg.text: Bars show canonical 5-fold OOF performance. Right panels show signed pairwise deltas and FDR markers.
Contrast signs are candidate minus baseline. Intervals are shown for bootstrap tests; DeLong rows carry p/q markers without bootstrap CIs.
